attendance_make_up_done_check.name: attendance_make_up_done_check
attendance_make_up_done_check.value: ("attendance_make_up"."status" = 'done') = ("attendance_make_up"."done_at" IS NOT NULL AND "attendance_make_up"."done_by" IS NOT NULL)

enrollment_order_whole_pesos_check.name: enrollment_order_whole_pesos_check
enrollment_order_whole_pesos_check.value:
"enrollment_order"."fee_centavos" % 100 = 0
          AND "enrollment_order"."materials_centavos" % 100 = 0
          AND "enrollment_order"."total_centavos" % 100 = 0
          AND ("enrollment_order"."paid_amount_centavos" IS NULL OR "enrollment_order"."paid_amount_centavos" % 100 = 0)

enrollment_order_paid_state_check.name: enrollment_order_paid_state_check
enrollment_order_paid_state_check.value:
("enrollment_order"."status" = 'pending_confirmation'
            AND "enrollment_order"."paid_at" IS NULL
            AND "enrollment_order"."paid_amount_centavos" IS NULL)
          OR ("enrollment_order"."status" IN ('paid', 'materials_requested', 'materials_received')
            AND "enrollment_order"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL
            AND "enrollment_order"."paid_amount_centavos" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("enrollment_order"."status" = 'cancelled'
            AND ("enrollment_order"."paid_at" IS NULL) = ("enrollment_order"."paid_amount_centavos" IS NULL))

material_image_pair_check.name: material_image_pair_check
material_image_pair_check.value:
("material"."image_asset_id" IS NULL AND "material"."image_alt" IS NULL)
          OR ("material"."image_asset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "material"."image_alt" IS NOT NULL
              AND btrim("material"."image_alt") <> '')

intensive_workshop_percentage_teacher_ch.name: intensive_workshop_percentage_teacher_check
intensive_workshop_percentage_teacher_ch.value: "intensive_workshop"."agreed_percentage_bp" IS NULL OR "intensive_workshop"."teacher_id" IS NOT NULL

monthly_workshop_percentage_teacher_chec.name: monthly_workshop_percentage_teacher_check
monthly_workshop_percentage_teacher_chec.value: "monthly_workshop"."agreed_percentage_bp" IS NULL OR "monthly_workshop"."teacher_id" IS NOT NULL
